sandhi: caturbhiḥ + jagatī; instrumental numeral with nominative feminine noun

items.question: What proportional heights are prescribed for the base and the platform course?
premises: The height of the base is specified as one part.
The platform course is specified as four parts.
These measurements are given as prescriptive proportions.
items.inference: The base should measure one part in height while the platform course should measure four parts.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of upānaka in this context is inferred from common usage.
The unit of the part is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: The height of the base should be one part, but the platform course should be four parts.
